data.raw_text:
As space activity accelerates, the focus is gradually shifting from expansion to coordination. Space Situational Awareness and Space Traffic Management are becoming foundational to ensuring safe and reliable operations in orbit.

At the ASEAN SSA and STM workshop in Manila, @the_wolfmeister (VP - Business & Strategy) engaged with policymakers and technical experts shaping this conversation, sharing our perspective on the importance of structured space traffic coordination and more coherent approaches to orbital management.

The future of space will depend not just on access, but on how responsibly and intelligently it is managed.

@UNOOSA @GISTDA @PhilSpaceAgency
